description:
### What's new

- **T9 (SkipCmpScreen)**: bypasses the Usercentrics consent screen and the
  synchronous fetch wait that holds the splash on cold start. App goes
  directly to the notification-permission prompt, then the feed.
- **T1 (RedirectTrackerUrls)**: extends the localhost redirect map with the
  three Usercentrics CMP-core hosts (`aggregator.service.usercentrics.eu`,
  `api.usercentrics.eu`, `consent-api.service.consent.usercentrics.eu`).
  The SDK falls back to "reject all" on unreachable, verified empirically.

### Files

- `pepper-patches.rvp` — patch bundle for ReVanced Manager / CLI
- `pepperpl-8.13.00.xapk` — patched Pepper PL (no debug menu)
- `pepperpl-8.13.00-debug.xapk` — patched Pepper PL with debug menu enabled

Install the XAPK with SAI / APKMirror Installer / ReVanced Manager.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/PawiX25/pepper-revanced-patches/compare/v1.2.0...v1.3.0

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/PawiX25/pepper-revanced-patches/compare/v1.1.1...v1.3.0
